```{r}
# Data Cleaning

## Remove fully empty or irrelevant columns
dat <- dat %>%
  select(-non_target)  # 100% missing, not useful
```


```{r}
## Handle categorical traits: replace NA with "Unknown"
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(
    ffg   = ifelse(is.na(ffg), "Unknown", ffg),
    habit = ifelse(is.na(habit), "Unknown", habit),
    family = ifelse(is.na(family), "Unknown", family),
    class  = ifelse(is.na(class), "Unknown", class),
    order  = ifelse(is.na(order), "Unknown", order)
  )

## Ensure numeric columns are numeric
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(across(c(total, total300, is_distinct, is_distinct300, ptv), as.numeric))

## Create unified abundance column 
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(abund = coalesce(total300, total))

## Remove rows with no abundance data (essential for analysis)
dat <- dat %>% filter(!is.na(total) & total > 0)

## Standardize text categories
dat <- dat %>%
  mutate(across(c(state, target_taxon, family, genus), ~str_trim(toupper(.))))

## Keep only first visits / relevant visits (avoid double-counting)
dat <- dat %>%
  filter(visit_no %in% c("1","R","2"))

## Keep only sampled sites
dat <- dat %>%
  filter(sitesamp == "Y")

dat1 <- dat |>
  mutate(taxon = if_else(!is.na(genus) & genus != "", genus, family))


```

```{r}
library(tidyr)

```

```{r}
# Data Preparation

## Choose taxon level
dat <- dat |>
  mutate(taxon = if_else(!is.na(genus) & genus != "", genus, family))

## Build site metadata (one row per site-visit)
site_meta <- dat |>
  distinct(uid, site_id, unique_id, state, epa_reg, ag_eco9, date_col, visit_no, sample_type)

## Build community matrix (site × taxon)
comm <- dat |>
  group_by(uid, taxon) |>
  summarise(abund = sum(abund, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = taxon, values_from = abund, values_fill = 0)

# Keep numeric matrix plus matching metadata
comm_mat <- comm |> select(-uid) |> as.data.frame()
rownames(comm_mat) <- comm$uid

# Align site_meta to comm rows
site_meta2 <- site_meta |> filter(uid %in% rownames(comm_mat)) |>
  arrange(match(uid, rownames(comm_mat)))


# Quick check
dim(comm_mat)
head(site_meta2)

```

# Q1
```{r}
library(vegan)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

# ---- Biodiversity metrics ----
richness <- specnumber(comm_mat)
shannon  <- diversity(comm_mat, index = "shannon")
simpson  <- diversity(comm_mat, index = "simpson")

alpha <- site_meta2 %>%
  mutate(richness = richness,
         shannon = shannon,
         simpson = simpson)

# ---- EPT richness ----
tax_tab <- dat %>% distinct(taxon, order)
ept_taxa <- tax_tab %>%
  filter(order %in% c("EPHEMEROPTERA", "PLECOPTERA", "TRICHOPTERA")) %>%
  pull(taxon) %>% unique()

alpha$ept_richness <- rowSums(comm_mat[, colnames(comm_mat) %in% ept_taxa] > 0, na.rm = TRUE)
alpha$ept_prop <- alpha$ept_richness / alpha$richness

# ---- Visualizations ----
p11<- ggplot(alpha, aes(x=ag_eco9, y=shannon, fill=ag_eco9)) +
  geom_boxplot() + coord_flip() +
  labs(x="Ecoregion (AG_ECO9)", y="Shannon diversity") +
  theme(legend.position="none")

p12<-ggplot(alpha, aes(state, richness)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill="lightgray", color="black") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x="State", y="Taxon richness")

boxplot(alpha$richness, alpha$ept_richness,
        names=c("Richness","EPT Richness"),
        col=c("skyblue","lightgreen"),
        main="Species and EPT Richness per Site",
        ylab="Number of Taxa")


boxplot(ept_prop ~ ag_eco9, data=alpha,
        main="EPT Proportion by Ecoregion",
        xlab="Ecoregion", ylab="EPT Proportion",
        las=2, col="lightgreen")

ggsave("figs/diversity_by_ecoregion.png", p11, width=7, height=5, dpi=300)
ggsave("figs/richness_by_state.png", p12, width=7, height=5, dpi=300)

```







# Pollution tolerance & water quality (Q2)
```{r}
# Build a taxon→PTV look up (use best available PTV at chosen level)
ptv_lu <- dat |>
  distinct(taxon, ptv) 
```

```{r}
# Compute CWM PTV for each site
# align look up to comm_mat columns
ptv_vec <- ptv_lu$ptv[match(colnames(comm_mat), ptv_lu$taxon)]

cwm_ptv <- function(abund_row, trait){
  w <- abund_row
  ok <- !is.na(trait) & trait >= 0
  if(!any(w[ok] > 0)) return(NA_real_)
  sum(w[ok] * trait[ok]) / sum(w[ok])
}

cwm <- apply(comm_mat, 1, cwm_ptv, trait = ptv_vec)

alpha <- alpha |> mutate(cwm_ptv = cwm)

```

```{r}
# Visualize & test differences
p3 <- ggplot(alpha, aes(ag_eco9, cwm_ptv)) + geom_boxplot() + coord_flip() +
  labs(x="Ecoregion", y="Community-weighted PTV")

ggsave("figs/cwm_ptv_by_ecoregion.png", p3, width=7, height=5, dpi=300)

# Quick ANOVA (exploratory)
summary(aov(cwm_ptv ~ ag_eco9, data = alpha))


```
```{r}
ggplot(alpha, aes(x = ag_eco9, y = ept_richness / richness)) +

ggplot(alpha, aes(x = ag_eco9, y = cwm_ptv)) +
```

# Functional traits (FFG, HABIT) (Q3)
```{r}
unique(dat$ffg)
unique(dat$habit)

```

```{r}
# Define FFG and HABIT codes
ffg_levels <- c("CG", "CF", "SC", "SH", "PI", "PA")  
habit_levels <- c("BU", "SP", "CN", "DV", "CB", "PK")


ffg_levels_present <- intersect(ffg_levels, unique(unlist(strsplit(dat$ffg, ","))))
habit_levels_present <- intersect(habit_levels, unique(unlist(strsplit(dat$habit, ","))))

ffg_levels_present <- intersect(ffg_levels, unique(unlist(strsplit(dat$ffg, ","))))
habit_levels_present <- intersect(habit_levels, unique(unlist(strsplit(dat$habit, ","))))
```

```{r}
# Compute site-level proportions
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# FFG
ffg_long <- dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(ffg)) %>%
  separate_rows(ffg, sep = ",")  # split multiple codes into separate rows

ffg_site <- ffg_long %>%
  group_by(uid, ffg) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = ffg, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)

ffg_prop <- ffg_site %>%
  mutate(total = rowSums(across(all_of(ffg_levels_present)))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(ffg_levels_present), ~.x / total)) %>%
  select(-total)

# HABIT
habit_long <- dat %>%
  filter(!is.na(habit)) %>%
  separate_rows(habit, sep = ",")

habit_site <- habit_long %>%
  group_by(uid, habit) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = habit, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)

habit_prop <- habit_site %>%
  mutate(total = rowSums(across(all_of(habit_levels_present)))) %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(habit_levels_present), ~.x / total)) %>%
  select(-total)

```

```{r}
# Join with site metadata
ffg_prop$uid <- as.character(ffg_prop$uid)
habit_prop$uid <- as.character(habit_prop$uid)
site_meta2$uid <- as.character(site_meta2$uid)

ffg_meta <- site_meta2 %>% left_join(ffg_prop, by="uid")
habit_meta <- site_meta2 %>% left_join(habit_prop, by="uid")

```

```{r}
# Summarize by eco region
ffg_summary <- ffg_meta %>%
  group_by(ag_eco9) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(ffg_levels_present), ~mean(.x, na.rm=TRUE)))

habit_summary <- habit_meta %>%
  group_by(ag_eco9) %>%
  summarise(across(all_of(habit_levels_present), ~mean(.x, na.rm=TRUE)))

```

# Community composition & indicator taxa (Q4)

```{r}
# Load packages
library(vegan)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(indicspecies)
library(readr)

# ---------------------------
# 1. Filter rare taxa
# ---------------------------
# Keep taxa present in at least 5% of sites
taxa_pres <- colSums(comm_mat > 0) / nrow(comm_mat)
comm_filtered <- comm_mat[, taxa_pres >= 0.05]

# ---------------------------
# 2. Hellinger transformation (for NMDS & PERMANOVA)
# ---------------------------
comm_hell <- decostand(comm_filtered, method = "hellinger")

# ---------------------------
# 3. NMDS
# ---------------------------
set.seed(123)
nmds <- metaMDS(comm_hell, k = 2, trymax = 50, autotransform = FALSE)

# Prepare NMDS data frame
nmds_df <- as.data.frame(nmds$points) %>%
  mutate(uid = rownames(.)) %>%
  inner_join(site_meta2, by = "uid")

# NMDS plot
p_nmds <- ggplot(nmds_df, aes(MDS1, MDS2, color = ag_eco9)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
  labs(title = "NMDS of macroinvertebrate communities", color = "Ecoregion") +
  theme_minimal()
ggsave("figs/nmds_by_ecoregion.png", p_nmds, width = 6, height = 5, dpi = 300)
p_nmds

# ---------------------------
# 4. PERMANOVA
# ---------------------------
adonis2(comm_hell ~ ag_eco9, data = site_meta2, permutations = 999)

# ---------------------------
# 5. Indicator Species Analysis (IndVal)
# ---------------------------
grp <- factor(site_meta2$ag_eco9)

# Convert to presence/absence (optional but standard for IndVal)
comm_pa <- decostand(comm_filtered, method = "pa")

set.seed(123)
ind <- multipatt(comm_pa, grp, func = "r.g", duleg = TRUE, max.order = 1, control = how(nperm = 999))

# Extract significant indicators
ind_res <- ind$sign %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  rownames_to_column("taxon") %>%
  arrange(p.value) %>%
  filter(p.value <= 0.05) %>%
  slice(1:20)  # Top 20 indicator taxa



```


```{r}
# Ordination (NMDS) with vegan
library(vegan)
set.seed(123)
comm_hell <- decostand(comm_mat, method = "hellinger")
nmds <- metaMDS(comm_hell, k=2, trymax=50, autotransform=FALSE)

nmds_df <- as.data.frame(nmds$points) |>
  mutate(uid = rownames(.)) |>
  inner_join(site_meta2, by="uid")

p5 <- ggplot(nmds_df, aes(MDS1, MDS2, color = ag_eco9)) +
  geom_point(alpha=0.7) +
  labs(title="NMDS of macroinvertebrate communities", color="Ecoregion")
ggsave("figs/nmds_by_ecoregion.png", p5, width=6, height=5, dpi=300)

```

```{r}

adonis2(comm_hell ~ ag_eco9, data = site_meta2, permutations = 999)

```

```{r}
# Indicator species analysis (indicspecies)
library(indicspecies)

grp <- factor(site_meta2$ag_eco9)
set.seed(123)
ind <- multipatt(comm_mat, grp, func = "r.g", duleg = TRUE, max.order = 1, control = how(nperm=999))

ind_res <- ind$sign |> as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("taxon") |>
  arrange(p.value) |>
  filter(p.value <= 0.05) |>
  slice(1:20)   # top 20 indicators

write_csv(ind_res, "data/processed/indicator_taxa_top20.csv")

```
